requests: Whether the 3300 PSI pressure washer can be used to apply the cleaner (soft wash)
Whether there is any reason not to use the pressure washer for this
What the preferred method of applying the cleaner is
Preference: introduce the cleaner downstream with a dispenser rather than through the pump
reason: The reply says yes, the pressure washer and soap can be used. It gives reasons against it: lifting wood fibers, soaking the wood so it takes days to dry, and ladder safety. It names a brush on an extension pole as the preferred method. The downstream-dispenser point is a stated preference rather than a separate question, so not discussing injection setup does not leave an explicit request unanswered. There is some uncertainty about whether that preference should count as a material constraint.
label: Fully answered
